The impeached circular of the Registrar was illegal and unwarranted. B
The Registrar has no power to interpret rule 409. The Registrar has equally no power to express view with regard to the conduct of the election and

Under rule 409 the principal matters to be kept in the fore-front are these. First, the society will divide the constituencies

Some reliance was placed by counsel for the appellants on

Rule 105 occurs in Chapter VII relating to meetings and speaks
of matters before a committee being decided by a majority of vobls

election but only to passing of resolution by majority at meetings.
It is obvious that members of the committee of management will D
have the right to vote at all matters at the meeting and matters
will be decided by a majority of votes.
The impeached circular of the Registrar is illegal and unwar-ranted Registrar has no power to iDterptet rule 409. The Re-gistrar has equally no power to eKpreSS view with regard to conduct

The result is that the elections which were held follbwing the
